SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
...When you're with Kirino and her friends, do you go 
around Akiba like this as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, more or less.

I answered Ayase's question as I bit into the kebab 
I'd just bought.

Next to me, Ayase was also eating a kebab. The 
otakus walking past us would stop, turn their heads 
and look at us.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hmm, is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So what's next? We've gone around to the 
moderate places already.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: T-Those were moderate...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, the deeper places go pretty deep though...

And very narrow. Honestly, I don't really have much 
confidence in being able to keep up.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That might be a bit much... Ah.

With that, Ayase suddenly stopped. Her gaze 
turned to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: There's something on your cheek.
As Ayase said that, she tapped the side of her face.
Seems like there's some bits of food stuck there.

As I tried to remove it in a panic, Ayase froze up 
for some reason.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Don't move for a second, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

Ayase drew closer to my face and then with her 
lips...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]W-What are you doing?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Geez... what did I..? I-I was just taking the leftovers 
on your cheek.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ayase-san sure is bold, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
It... It's not like that! I was honestly thinking of 
removing those leftovers for you!

Hey now, Ayase-san. That was the wrong method 
for being 'honest.'
Ah~ Ayase-tan is so cute.

And at the moment where things had somehow 
gone well for us...
Suddenly, my phone mail notification rang.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Gah, just who is it now?!

I unconsciously cursed as I checked my mail and 
then, suddenly, a feeling of dread came over me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
How is the date going, Kyousuke-shi?  lω・`） 
Peek
Somehow that smiley really irritated me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So it's you...

The message contents somehow reminded me of 
the image of Saori's mouth in this ( ω ) kind of a 
smile.
And it was a pretty long message.
My head started to hurt.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Have you finished visiting my recommendations on 
the map? I did it in a hurry, so I was worried I 
might've missed something.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Or are you already doing this and that with your 
girlfriend?!
I'm not! What are you thinking of me...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Oh yes, Kyousuke-shi! Pardon my sudden 
suggestion but there's this perfect spot for couples!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Akiba has what's called an 'adult' convenience store...

I read up to that point and closed my phone 
without a word. My feelings? No comment.
And we had such a good mood going earlier too...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, um... Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, sorry. I got a mail from someone I know.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Someone you know...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uhh...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Who is it from?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: From Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Saori-san...
H...Huh? Ayase appears to be...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-Is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Erm, about that mail...  [font_size=28]Mind if I take a 
look？[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Why, you say... That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I was just thinking... you're not being unfaithful, are 
you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

Where did she get that from!? I was just reading a 
mail, right!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Is that a 'no?'

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, okay.

Looks like I can clear up this misunderstanding 
easily, so I might as well.
And besides, those eyes are kinda scary, Ayase-san!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Really?!

Ayase took the phone from me and quickly started 
reading the mail.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, letting you see the mail is a bit too...

Showing Ayase the kind of content that mail held 
wouldn't do me any good.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Is... Is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ayase-san?
